verdict.rationale: OpenRouter documents management endpoints for programmatically creating, distributing and rotating API keys for applications (docs-8). These are OpenRouter-issued keys sitting in front of pooled provider access, with optional BYOK so raw provider keys stay at the gateway (docs-9, docs-45). A community user independently confirms that minting keys with per-key expiry and limits is easy (comm-12), and workspace budgets support team-level spend scoping (docs-10). Missing for 10: explicit documentation that BYOK provider keys are never exposed to key holders, and detail on team/app-scoped key assignment such as workspace-to-key mapping and permissions.
